title: Monsoon Protocol
tagline: The storm is the cover. The city is the target.
synopsis: When a cyber-attack cripples Mumbai's flood-control grid on the wettest night of the year, a suspended police analyst has twelve hours to find the hacker before the sea walls open.

title: The Last Lighthouse
tagline: Some lights are meant to keep things out.
synopsis: A marine biologist takes a winter post at a remote lighthouse and begins receiving signals from a ship that sank forty years ago.

title: Kaagaz Ke Sapne
tagline: Paper dreams don't sink. They sail.
synopsis: A ten-year-old from a Varanasi ghat folds a thousand paper boats to win a city art contest and pay for her grandfather's surgery.

title: Orbit 9
synopsis: After a solar flare cripples a research station around Saturn, the crew discovers their rescue capsule was built for one person fewer than they are.

title: Neon Bazaar
tagline: One night. One market. Seven very bad plans.
synopsis: Three friends running a failing electronics stall in Delhi's night market get mixed up in a diamond heist that everyone, including the thieves, is getting wrong.

title: Vettai
tagline: In the forest, the hunter becomes the hunted.
synopsis: A forest ranger in the Nilgiris goes after a poaching ring and finds the trail leads back to people she trusts.

title: Silent Frequency
tagline: Don't answer if it calls your name.
synopsis: A late-night radio host starts picking up a station that broadcasts tomorrow's emergencies, and tonight it is reading out her address.

title: Chai & Chaos
tagline: Two cafés. One street. Zero chill.
synopsis: Rival café owners in Bengaluru wage a war of discounts, reviews and secret recipes until a city food festival forces them to share a stall.

title: Kingdom of Sand
tagline: Empires fall. Legends rise from the dust.
synopsis: A desert queen of the 14th century unites three warring clans to defend a fortress city against an army ten times their size.

title: Pixel Hearts
tagline: Game over is just the beginning.
synopsis: When an old arcade is set to be demolished, the characters inside its forgotten games team up to escape into the real world.

title: The Ninth Over
synopsis: A washed-up fast bowler coaching a small-town women's cricket team gets one last shot when they reach a national final nobody expected them to play.

title: Echoes of Ladakh
synopsis: Two estranged brothers ride motorcycles across Ladakh to scatter their father's ashes at a lake he never told them about.
